acceptance.peaks: Nearest strict local maximum: within one unpadded Rayleigh bin 1/(N*dt), OR rounds to the guide value at its printed precision. Both subtests and the unrounded peak are reported. This prevents e.g. 1.82045 m from falsely failing a printed ~1.8 m claim.
acceptance.master_mtm: same frequency vector and relative power error below 1e-10
acceptance.replay: Exact MTM arrays and exact COCO arrays, with the journal restoring initial RNG state.
acceptance.plotting: each registered plotter must execute and create output
acceptance.qualitative: 405-kyr modulation, visual eCOCO pattern and visual wavelet bands require additional inspection; finite arrays alone do not verify these claims
